study type: Multicenter, prospective, observational, and cohort study
outcome: Sociodemographic changes in pregnant women living with HIV infection
Percentage of preterm and low birth weight newborns
cohort: 1521 HIV-infected mother-infant pairs in Madrid, Spain
finding: The epidemiologic characteristics of pregnant women with HIV infection have changed over time, with an increase of non-Caucasian, heterosexual, and perinatally infected mothers, while the perinatal transmission rate has markedly decreased.
mod_finding: The proportion of Caesarean sections decreased over time.
